module: Node "Send Message" (thread). Sends a message (table of the non-fixed input pins) to the flowgraph project with the given id (-1 = parent) via modules.thread:sendMessage, or sendNetworkedMessage if the networked pin is true. Sends only once until reset. Fixed pins: flow, reset, networked, id, name; output flow.
notes: The name pin (message name) is fixed so it is not added to the message content.
The result of sendMessage is not used.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: On reset, done = false; otherwise, on flow with an id, assembles the non-fixed pins into a table and sends the message, then copies flow.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.
